title: March Madness Bracket Definition
description: Data-driven bracket graph used by the website to render regions, resolve slot dependencies, and fill through later rounds without hardcoded UI logic.

season.description: Tournament season represented by this bracket graph.

regions.description: Ordered list of region labels used by the bracket UI.

slots.description: Every bracket slot, including play-ins, regionals, Final Four, and championship nodes.

final_slots.description: Named references for the late-round slots that the web app highlights specially.

seedReference.title: Seed Reference
seedReference.description: A slot side that starts from a seeded team rather than an upstream winner.

team_id.description: TeamID placed into this slot at bracket initialization.

seed.description: Seed value associated with the opening slot, or null for nonstandard cases.

winnerReference.title: Winner Reference
winnerReference.description: A slot side that is fed by the winner of an earlier slot.

source_slot.description: Slot identifier that supplies the winner for this side of the matchup.

slot.title: Bracket Slot
slot.description: A single node in the tournament dependency graph.
Unique slot identifier used throughout the UI and fill-through logic.

label.description: Human-readable round label for this slot.

region.description: Region or stage name for display grouping.

round.description: Numeric round order used for rendering and dependency traversal.

next_slot.description: Downstream slot that receives the winner of this matchup, or null for the championship node.
